meta.label: Healthcare quality: prevention by region (2024)
meta.methodNote: Ministero della Salute's Nuovo Sistema di Garanzia (NSG) CORE-indicator score for collective prevention and public health (vaccination coverage, screening uptake, food/veterinary safety controls), per region, 2024 — the newest year published (approved by the Comitato LEA 14 May 2026). Score 0-100; 60 is the official "sufficiency" threshold below which a region is not considered compliant for this macro-area. A HIGHER score means BETTER assessed care — this is a positive-direction indicator, the opposite direction from this map's crime and air-quality layers.
meta.coverageNote: NSG-LEA scores Trentino-Alto Adige's two autonomous provinces — Bolzano and Trento — SEPARATELY rather than as one region, and they can score very differently (e.g. Prevenzione 2024: Bolzano 59, Trento 98). This map's region grain has one shared "Trentino-Alto Adige" label covering both provinces' comuni, so there is no honest single figure to show there — omitted here rather than averaged or standing one province's score in for the other's. 19/20 regions carry a real value.
